messages.text: can you explain how solving a block nets you $1,656 worth of pepecoin?
That number isn't ours — the H15 Dual doesn't touch pepecoin. It mines Bitcoin and, on the scrypt side, Dogecoin, at $799, shipping November 30. Where did you see the pepecoin figure?
its right there on the page, pepecoin is scrypt btw

Fair point — pepecoin is scrypt, so the H15's scrypt side can point at a pepecoin pool. That dollar figure is a calculator output at today's price and difficulty, not a fixed payout; it moves with both, and a block is a lottery draw, not a schedule.

What do you pay per kWh?
a block of pepecoin is 10000 pepecoins the current price of 1 pepecoin is 0.00008613. Why does this page say if this miner solves a block it would get $1656 worth???
Handed to the team · Page block-reward figure for pepecoin can't be reconciled; won't guess at a numb

Your math is the one I'd trust: 10,000 × $0.00008613 is about $0.86, nowhere near $1,656. I won't guess at where that number comes from, so I've put it in front of the team to check the page figure. They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.

What the H15 Dual is, honestly: $799, ships (address hidden), Bitcoin on one side and scrypt on the other, pointed at whatever pool you like.
